dialogues.speaker: Mayu
dialogues.text: Hello, please complete your harbor entry registration here. Passengers will be taken care of by the Flower-Feather Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Grzymislawa
dialogues.text: I never imagined a simple harbor would be so well-prepared... Out there on the waves, I wasn't sure what we would do when we made landfall. I can't thank you enough.

dialogues.speaker: Grzymislawa
dialogues.text: The situation in Nod-Krai is starting to look up, and having this harbor here will make it a lot more convenient to trade once things are back to normal.

dialogues.speaker: Mayu
dialogues.text: Haha, you should thank the Pyro Archon! It was she who talked to the Flower-Feather Clan's elders and arranged to establish this harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Mayu
dialogues.text: Oh, and you might want to thank Mr. Zhuoxin, too. He's provided us with a wealth of information on Nod-Krai and no small amount of advice on how to set up the harbor.
